operations: Research and pin supported Kotlin/Android/Compose/Room/DataStore/test/Gradle dependency versions from official sources.
Create reproducible Gradle Android foundation, app shell, test harness, formatting/lint and CI.
Run packet test/build gates without introducing app network, account, analytics SDK, or production expense behavior.
planner.rollback: Changes are confined to a new Android/Gradle foundation and CI. Preserve all existing docs/workflow content; if review rejects the foundation, restore only BT-005-created files from the task baseline and do not delete pre-existing files.

securityPreflight.scope: BT-005 foundation only: listed Gradle bootstrap, native app shell, pure Kotlin core modules, test harness, formatting/lint setup, least-privilege GitHub Actions CI, ignore/setup docs, and task evidence. Pin exact versions and resolve coordinates against authoritative metadata. No app network/accounts/analytics, production expense behavior, database migration/restore, overlay, signing, publishing, destructive action, or unrelated upgrade. Preserve existing workflow/docs/spike; capture baseline before owned edits; run only scoped task gates.

findings.description: Resolve all proposed plugin, SDK, and AndroidX coordinates against authoritative metadata; exclude dynamic versions, snapshots, and insecure repositories.
CI must use least privilege (contents: read) and no repository secrets; accurately record missing Linux Android tools and unusable Git metadata.
Capture baseline inventory/content before owned-file edits and restore only BT-005-owned changes if rejected.
